hardwareHubs.note: Lassonde Studios at the University of Utah has a 20,000 square foot prototyping space, and Make Salt Lake and a state STEM makerspace operate in the metro area.

makerspaces.name: Make Salt Lake
makerspaces.note: Nonprofit community makerspace whose site lists CNC machines, laser cutters, 3D printers and electronics equipment.

makerspaces.name: Utah STEM Action Center Innovation Hub
makerspaces.note: Makerspace with Bambu 3D printers, a Shapeoko CNC router, a Tormach CNC mill and an Epilog laser, part of the U-MAKE network.

makerspaces.name: Utah Tech University Makerspace
makerspaces.note: Nearly 8,000 square feet with three CO2 lasers, CNC routers, 3D printers and a soldering station, open after free training.

programs.name: Lassonde Studios and Company Launch, University of Utah
programs.note: Startups-in-residence get office space, prototyping tool access and mentorship at the Lassonde Studios building.

specialties.name: Aerospace and defense
specialties.note: Utah names aerospace and defense as one of its seven strategic clusters, with Boeing announcing an 875,000 square foot expansion.

specialties.name: Outdoor products
specialties.note: The outdoor products and recreation cluster includes makers of skis, snowboards, climbing equipment and composite bicycle rims.

specialties.name: Advanced composites
specialties.note: A University of Utah document describes a 50 year history of an advanced composites cluster serving outdoor sports and medical devices.

support.name: University of Utah Manufacturing Extension Partnership (UUMEP) Center
support.note: The NIST MEP center for Utah, offering training and consulting to reduce costs and improve productivity, through the Utah-MEP Alliance.
